question.text: Provisions of PMLA came into force from:

explanation.text: **The Logic:** PMLA provisions came into force on July 1, 2005. **The Trap:** PMLA Act was 2002 but operational date is July 2005. **Cross-Exam Context:** Same fact in XXIV. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Quote both enactment year (2002) and operative date (2005) correctly.
